briefings.title: Tony Kim, BlackRock | theCUBE + NYSE Wired: AI Factories - Data Centers of the Future
briefings.tldr: The AI buildout remains in its early stages as model capabilities scale faster than capital expenditure, upending traditional technology assumptions by making semiconductors the world's most profitable sector while collapsing the traditional software stack.

briefings.title: The Evolving AI Landscape: A Conversation between SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen and BlackRock's Tony Kim
briefings.tldr: SpaceX Chief Financial Officer Bret Johnsen and BlackRock Global Technology Team Head Tony Kim discussed SpaceX's rapid scaling into AI infrastructure, projecting over $100 billion in annualized run rate (ARR) by the end of 2026, driven by a 1-year terrestrial compute payback and upcoming orbital compute deployments starting next year.

briefings.title: BlackRock's Tony Kim on AI's Next Winners? Chips, Memory, Robotics & Quantum

people.name: Tony Kim
people.role: Managing Director and Head of Global Technology Team, BlackRock

briefings.tldr: Tony Kim, Managing Director and Head of the Global Technology Team within Fundamental Equities at BlackRock, breaks down how the AI boom is triggering a massive $1 trillion to $10 trillion compute-centric infrastructure rebuild, shifting focus from a software-dominated world to the physical layers of compute, power density, and memory.

briefings.title: The Invisible Backbone of AI: Why Light Powers Intelligence | Lumentum | RAISE Summit 2026
briefings.tldr: Michael Hurlston, CEO of Lumentum, and Tony Kim of BlackRock discuss how the exponential rise of AI model sizes is forcing data centers to transition from copper wiring to photonics (optics) across a four-stage framework: scale across, scale out, scale up, and scale in.

briefings.title: Fireside Chat with Sid Sheth, Founder & CEO of d-Matrix | RAISE Summit 2026
briefings.tldr: Sid Sheth and Tony Kim discuss how d-Matrix's purpose-built inference hardware—transitioning from SRAM-based accelerators to 3D-stacked DRAM-on-compute architectures—addresses the unique demands of the agentic AI era by optimizing for interactivity and energy efficiency.

briefings.title: Conversation with BlackRock CEO Larry Fink & Brookfield Corp CEO Bruce Flatt | Global Conference '26
briefings.tldr: The global economy is undergoing a $10 trillion "rewiring" driven by AI infrastructure and energy needs, shifting investment toward massive private platforms that can match long-term liabilities with large-scale, compounding assets.

briefings.title: Brookfield's Bruce Flatt discusses the global markets at the Milken Institute Global Conference
briefings.tldr: The global economy is entering a $10 trillion "rewiring" phase driven by AI and digital infrastructure needs, shifting the investment landscape from traditional assets to long-term "continuity" assets managed by private capital firms rather than debt-constrained governments.

briefings.title: BlackRock CEO on if US-Iran conflict could derail economy as gas prices surge
briefings.tldr: BlackRock CEO Larry Fink views current geopolitical volatility as a long-term "buying opportunity," asserting that the U.S. economy is entering a transformational era driven by a $10 trillion infrastructure need and AI-led productivity, which necessitates a massive reinvestment in skilled domestic labor.

briefings.title: Blackrock Infrastructure Summit: Future Builders | Semafor Media Partner
briefings.tldr: BlackRock is launching a $100 million "Future Builders" initiative to address a critical skilled labor shortage that threatens U.S. infrastructure and global competitiveness.

briefings.title: Mukesh Ambani & Larry Fink In Fireside Chat | The Future Of Global Finance & Business

people.name: Mukesh Ambani
people.role: Chairman and Managing Director, Reliance Industries

briefings.tldr: India is entering a 20- to 30-year "Era of India" characterized by 8–10% GDP growth; the JioBlackRock partnership aims to capitalize on this by using technology to convert India’s massive "unproductive" savings (gold and bank deposits) into compoundable capital market investments.

briefings.title: LIVE: BlackRock CEO Larry Fink, Reliance Chairman Mukesh Ambani speaks on Future of global business
briefings.tldr: BlackRock CEO Larry Fink and Reliance Chairman Mukesh Ambani affirmed that India is entering a multi-decade "era of India" driven by sustained economic growth, stable leadership, and rapid technological adoption, emphasizing the critical need for domestic capital market investment to unlock its full potential.
